questions.stem:
Find the ODD ONE OUT:
A) Apple  B) Mango  C) Banana  D) Rose
questions.explanation: D is correct. Apple, Mango, and Banana are all fruits. Rose is a flower — it belongs to a different category (not a fruit). The odd one out is D (Rose).

questions.stem:
Find the ODD ONE OUT:
A) Violin  B) Guitar  C) Sitar  D) Trumpet
questions.explanation: D is correct. Violin, Guitar, and Sitar are all string instruments (chordophones). Trumpet is a wind instrument (brass) — you blow air through it. The odd one out is D (Trumpet).

questions.stem:
Find the ODD ONE OUT:
A) Square  B) Circle  C) Rectangle  D) Triangle
questions.explanation: B is correct. Square, Rectangle, and Triangle are all polygons (closed figures with straight sides). Circle has no straight sides or corners — it is a curved shape. The odd one out is B (Circle).

questions.stem:
Find the ODD ONE OUT:
A) Mercury  B) Venus  C) Titan  D) Mars
questions.explanation: C is correct. Mercury, Venus, and Mars are all planets in our Solar System. Titan is a MOON of Saturn — it is a natural satellite, not a planet. The odd one out is C (Titan).

questions.stem:
Find the ODD ONE OUT:
A) Eagle  B) Cow  C) Tiger  D) Bat
questions.explanation: A is correct. Cow, Tiger, and Bat are all mammals (warm-blooded, breathe air, nurse young with milk). Eagle is a bird — not a mammal. Note: Bat is the classic trap — students often assume bats are not mammals because they fly, but bats ARE mammals.

questions.stem:
Find the ODD ONE OUT:
A) Violin  B) Piano  C) Flute  D) Harp
questions.explanation: C is correct. Violin, Piano, and Harp all produce sound by strings being plucked, struck, or bowed — they are string instruments. Flute produces sound by blowing air across an opening — it is a wind instrument. The odd one out is C (Flute).

questions.stem:
Find the ODD ONE OUT:
A) Virus  B) Fungi  C) Antibiotic  D) Bacteria
questions.explanation: C is correct. Virus, Fungi, and Bacteria are all microorganisms (living agents that can cause disease). Antibiotic is a MEDICINE used to treat bacterial infections — not a microorganism. The odd one out is C (Antibiotic).

questions.stem:
Find the ODD ONE OUT:
A) Delhi  B) Mumbai  C) Paris  D) Kolkata
questions.explanation: C is correct. Delhi, Mumbai, and Kolkata are all major cities in India. Paris is the capital city of France — not in India. The odd one out is C (Paris).

questions.stem:
Find the ODD ONE OUT:
A) Chlorophyll  B) Haemoglobin  C) Melanin  D) Insulin
questions.explanation: D is correct. Chlorophyll (green, in plants), Haemoglobin (red, in blood), and Melanin (skin/hair pigment) are all pigments — substances that give colour. Insulin is a HORMONE produced by the pancreas that regulates blood sugar — not a pigment. The odd one out is D (Insulin).

questions.stem:
Find the ODD ONE OUT:
A) Kangaroo  B) Shark  C) Whale  D) Dolphin
questions.explanation: B is correct. Kangaroo, Whale, and Dolphin are all mammals — they are warm-blooded, breathe air, and nurse young with milk. Shark is a fish (a cartilaginous fish) — cold-blooded, breathes through gills. The classic trap: Whales and Dolphins live in water but are mammals, not fish. The odd one out is B (Shark).
